subject: URGENT: third late delivery this month – Christmas range at risk
body:
Ana,

This is the third delivery from Douro Cellars that arrives late this month (SHP-24117, SHP-24131 and now SHP-24138 with our Vintage Port 2017 for the Christmas range). Our Christmas range launches in 87 stores on 1 November and the Vintage Port shelf space is still empty.

Before our QBR on Tuesday I need a written recovery plan with confirmed delivery dates. If we cannot rely on your dates, we will have to review our supplier allocation for 2027.

Regards,
Sofia Almeida
Head of Purchasing, Zava Lisboa

subject: Delivery SHP-24117 arrived 5 days late
body: Hi Ana, the delivery for SHP-24117 only arrived today, 5 days after the promised date. Please make sure the next ones arrive on time. Sofia

subject: RE: Delivery SHP-24117 arrived 5 days late
body: Hi Sofia, I'm sorry about the delay – we had a picking backlog at our Gaia warehouse. It's resolved and your next deliveries are on track. Ana

subject: Christmas campaign – confirming 1,100 cases of 10 Year Tawny for 30 Oct
body: Hi Ana, confirming our Christmas order: 1,100 cases of 10 Year Old Tawny for delivery on 30 October. Our in-store tasting campaign starts on 9 November across 140 shops – the team is excited! James

subject: RE: Christmas campaign – confirming 1,100 cases of 10 Year Tawny for 30 Oct
body: Thanks James, order received. Looking forward to the campaign! Ana

subject: Canceled: Northwind – Annual tasting & 2027 planning
body: Hi Ana, I have to cancel our tasting and 2027 planning on 15 October because of an internal restructuring of our purchasing team. I will come back to you. Lukas

subject: September order
body: Hi Ana, please find our September order attached. We are reducing volumes a bit while we review our range for 2027. Best, Lukas

subject: Heads-up: 10 Year Tawny bottling run moved to 16 Nov
body: Hi both, the next 10 Year Old Tawny bottling run moved to 16 November (glass supplier delay). Free stock is tight until then – please check big open orders. Pedro

subject: Pedido entregado con retraso / late delivery
body: Hola, our last order arrived 4 days late. Please confirm the next delivery date. Javier

subject: Thanks for the quick fix
body: Hi Tiago, the delivery came one day late because of customs, but your team handled it well. All good on our side. Emily

subject: November order and QBR date
body: Hi Ana, November order as usual – and 4 November works for our QBR. Lena

subject: Q4 forecast
body: Hi Beatriz, our Q4 forecast is in line with last year. See you at the QBR on 29 Oct. Camila
